name: DropdownMenu
summary: Reveal a portaled menu of actions or routes from a trigger. Single-select per item — items invoke actions immediately on activation. Supports nested sub-menus, dividers, label rows, danger items, keyboard shortcuts, checkboxes, and radio groups. Three triggers it covers: a button menu (kebab/overflow), a route menu (account, workspace switcher), and a right-click ContextMenu (variant via `trigger='context'`).

trigger.description: How the menu is opened. click: most common (kebab, account). hover: dropdowns on top-level Navbar items (debounced 100 ms enter / 200 ms leave). context: opens at the cursor on right-click / long-press.

open.description: Controlled open state. Pair with onOpenChange.

side.description: Preferred placement relative to the trigger. Floating-UI flips automatically if there's no room.

sideOffset.description: Gap between trigger and menu in pixels.

size.description: sm: 28 px row height (operator). md: 32 px (default).

loop.description: ArrowDown past last item loops to first; ArrowUp past first loops to last.

keyboard: Enter / Space / ArrowDown - open menu (on trigger)
ArrowDown / ArrowUp - move focus between items
Type-ahead first character - jump to matching item
ArrowRight - open submenu of focused item
ArrowLeft - close submenu, return focus to parent item
Escape - close menu, return focus to trigger
Tab - close menu, move focus past the trigger
rules: Menu has role='menu'; each item has role='menuitem' (or menuitemcheckbox / menuitemradio).

Per AGENTS.md hard rule 10 — the menu MUST portal to document.body and position via createPortal + getBoundingClientRect re-tracked on scroll (capture phase) + resize. Inline <div absolute> menus break under Card padding='none', glass surfaces, scroll containers.
Outside-click dismiss must exempt the portaled list (clicks on menu items should fire item handlers, not close-before-fire).
Returns focus to the trigger on close (mouse close, keyboard close, Escape, item activation).
Honor prefers-reduced-motion: skip the entry zoom-in-95; keep the fade and the position translation.

do: Lead each item with a verb: 'Delete account', 'Duplicate', 'Move to…'.
Group with dividers (≥ 4 items) and label rows (when groups have meaning).
Right-pad with the keyboard shortcut (the .lumen-kbd / Kbd component) when one exists.
Use danger-soft tint for destructive items (text.error + danger-soft bg hover) — solid danger fill is reserved for primary CTAs.
Width: menus auto-size to content with a sensible max-width (256 px desktop, 90vw mobile).
dont: Don't put 12+ items in a single menu. Group with dividers and/or use a nested submenu.
Don't use a DropdownMenu for a select control with persistent value — use Select.
Don't put a multi-select control inside a DropdownMenu — use Combobox / Popover-anchored CheckboxGroup.
Don't render the menu inline as an absolute child — it WILL clip under Card padding='none' (per hard rule 10).
Don't open submenus on hover only — they must also open on ArrowRight and on tap (mobile).

changelog.note: Initial DropdownMenu contract. Click/hover/context triggers. Portaled menu (AGENTS.md hard rule 10). Submenus, checkboxes, radio groups, danger-soft items, keyboard shortcuts.
